subject: Binding risk matrix & deployment annex — TideWave RFP follow-up
messages:
From: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@tidewavehealth.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: legal@tidewavehealth.com
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: TideWave RFP — liability/indemnity & deployment annex

Ben — thanks for the demo last week. TideWave's procurement/legal team is consolidating the RFP responses and we need a concise set of answers and evidence related to contractual risk allocation.

High level ask: can you send a populated risk matrix + order-form annex that addresses the following items?
- IP / output ownership (are customers assigned ownership of model outputs?)
- Indemnity scope for third-party IP claims
- Liability cap options (we need both an "entry" and an "enterprise" tier for procurement)
- Deployment options: hosted vs VPC vs on-prem; any additional charges
- Data residency & audit log retention policy (SOC2 evidence appreciated)

I've attached our RFP_RiskMatrix_Template.xlsx for you to populate. Our legal team has also prepared a tracked redline of proposed annex language — attaching separately once we have your initial responses.

Can you get back within 48 hours? Procurement is targeting vendor short-listing next week.

Thanks,
Emily Zhang
Director, Strategic Sourcing
TideWave Health
legal@tidewavehealth.com

Attachment: RFP_RiskMatrix_Template.xlsx (spreadsheet; 19 KB)

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@tidewavehealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: TideWave RFP — liability/indemnity & deployment annex

Emily — appreciate the clear ask and the template. Please find our initial populated risk matrix and a short order-form summary attached. Below are the high-level positions so your legal/procurement teams have something to react to quickly.

Attachments: Redwood_RiskMatrix_Response.xlsx; Redwood_Order_Form_Summary.pdf

Key positions (high level):
- IP / Outputs: Customers retain ownership of their Customer Data. For model outputs, we confirm customers are granted rights to use outputs. Redwood will not assert ownership over customer prompts or outputs in the Order Form; we propose language which grants customers an unrestricted license to outputs.
- Model training: Redwood will not use customer-provided prompts, data, or outputs to improve models without explicit written opt-in. We can include an opt-in clause in the Order Form for customers that want improvements.
- Indemnity: Redwood proposes mutual IP indemnity limited to infringement claims arising from the other party's materials. We exclude forward-looking consequential damages and place reasonable notice/cooperation obligations.
- Liability cap: We propose a tiered approach: for self-serve/hosted plans cap = greater of USD 100,000 or 3x monthly fees; for enterprise/Dedicated cap = greater of total subscription fees paid in prior 12 months or USD 1,500,000. We're open to negotiating to meet TideWave's procurement thresholds.
- Deployment annex: VPC/private deployment is available as an add-on; pricing and minimum commitment differ. Order Form summary attached with checkboxes for VPC, on-prem licensing, support SLA.

I've looped in Laura (Legal) to take point on the redline and Neha (Security) can follow up on SOC2/data-retention specifics if needed. If useful, we can schedule a 30-min redline review tomorrow morning.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@tidewavehealth.com>

Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 14:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: TideWave RFP — liability/indemnity & deployment annex

Ben — thanks for the fast turnaround. Our legal team had two immediate asks after reviewing your matrix:

1) Training/use of customer data: please confirm in writing that Redwood will not use any Customer Data, prompts, or outputs to train models without a separate contractual opt-in. We need explicit, unambiguous language for the RFP.

2) Output rights vs. model rights: our counsel wants the output assignment / license language to be explicit that TideWave has "exclusive use" of outputs for its internal business purposes and that Redwood will not commercially exploit those outputs in a way that exposes TideWave IP.

We've compiled a tracked redline of an annex that reflects those asks — attaching TideWave_Annex_Redline.docx. Also: can you confirm SOC2 Type II audit period and how long audit logs are retained? Procurement needs the SOC2 evidence to pass the security gate.

If you can confirm and provide the SOC2 redacted report and a short note on retention within 24 hours, we can move to legal redline review.

Thanks,
Emily

Attachment: TideWave_Annex_Redline.docx

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@tidewavehealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com; neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 19 Jun 2025 09:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: TideWave RFP — liability/indemnity & deployment annex

Emily — thanks for the redline. I reviewed the tracked changes and spoke with our security and product leads; below are suggested edits and a short explanation for each point so TideWave's counsel can see the rationale.

Quoted suggested clause language (extract):
"1. Customer Data and Outputs. Customer retains all right, title and interest in and to Customer Data. Redwood grants Customer a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, non-exclusive license to use Outputs produced by the Service for Customer's internal business purposes. Redwood will not use Customer Data or Outputs to train or improve models without Customer's prior written consent.
"2. Indemnity. Each party shall indemnify the other from third-party claims alleging that the indemnified party's materials infringe a third party's intellectual property rights, provided the indemnified party gives prompt notice and sole control of the defense to the indemnifying party.
"3. Limitation of Liability. Except for liability arising from a party's breach of Sections 1 (Customer Data) or 2 (Indemnity), or for willful misconduct, each party's aggregate liability for direct damages shall not exceed the greater of (a) the fees paid by Customer under the Order Form in the prior twelve (12) months, or (b) USD 2,000,000. No party shall be liable for lost profits, indirect, consequential or punitive damages.

Rationale/highlights:
- Training opt-in: product is engineered to honor customer opt-outs; we will include an explicit opt-in checkbox in the Order Form and a callout in the Annex.
- Output license vs exclusivity: Redwood can grant broad rights to Outputs but cannot agree to broad commercial exclusivity across all outputs and models (that would be operationally hard to enforce). We can offer a carve-out that prohibits Redwood from using Customer Identifiable Outputs to train models and from marketing those specific outputs.
- Liability cap: given the operational profile and SLA exposure, we propose the cap at fees-prior-12-months or USD 2M floor for enterprise customers. We are open to adjusting based on term and committed spend.

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_Redacted.pdf (redacted SOC2 Type II report)

Next steps: we propose a brief redline call Friday Jun 20 at 10:00 PT to walk through the clauses and finalize the Order Form exhibit. If that works, Ben will send a calendar invite.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Head of Legal | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

Attachment: Redwood_SOC2_Redacted.pdf

Emily — confirming the redline call is on for Jun 20 at 10:00 PT (invite sent). Quick recap / agreed items to prepare for the call so procurement has a clean checklist:

- IP & Outputs: customer retains Customer Data; Redwood will include a clear opt-in for training. Order Form will include explicit output license granting Customer rights for internal use; Redwood will not commercialize Customer Identifiable Outputs.
- Indemnity: mutual IP indemnity limited to claims arising out of the other party's materials; Redwood requires notice/cooperation and sole control of defense.
- Liability cap: initial proposal - fees prior 12 months OR USD 2,000,000 (whichever is greater) for enterprise/Dedicated. We can table the self-serve/hosted tier cap for now.
- Deployment annex: VPC & on-prem options available as paid add-ons; exhibit will list the minimum term and expected lead times.
- Evidence: SOC2 Type II redacted report attached; audit logs retained for 12 months by default, with extended retention available as an add-on.

Attachments: Redwood_RiskMatrix_Response.xlsx; Redwood_Order_Form_Summary.pdf; Redwood_SOC2_Redacted.pdf
